labels.quote: Exporting the weekly report takes us most of Friday afternoon
labels.note: The cost is time, and it recurs weekly.

labels.quote: someone always fat-fingers a column
labels.note: Accuracy, distinct from the time cost above.

labels.quote: We would love to just get it in Slack automatically on Monday morning
labels.note: Explicit request, with a channel and a time.

labels.quote: Every morning one of the dispatchers rebuilds the run sheet from three different screens
labels.note: Daily manual rebuild; ninety minutes of a dispatcher.

labels.quote: if a driver calls in sick after that, the whole thing gets rebuilt by hand
labels.note: Rework on disruption — a different failure from the daily build.

labels.quote: What I really want is for it to just redraw itself when someone drops out
labels.note: Stated in the customer's own words.

labels.quote: forty per cent of our tickets are people asking where a number came from
labels.note: Support volume with a stated cause.

labels.quote: Two of my analysts do almost nothing else
labels.note: Skilled staff misallocated — a distinct cost from ticket volume.

labels.quote: If the dashboard could show the lineage behind a figure
labels.note: Conditional phrasing, but it is a request.

labels.quote: Reconciliation is four people for three days
labels.note: Quantified effort; the late close is its consequence, not a second signal.

labels.quote: The matching rules live in a spreadsheet that only Karel understands
labels.note: Key-person risk, sharpened by the retirement date.

labels.quote: if the system suggested the matches and we just approved them
labels.note: Describes the workflow they want.

labels.quote: Our finance team re-keys about four hundred invoices a month into the old system
labels.note: Manual effort.

labels.quote: about one in twenty comes out wrong
labels.note: Error rate, with credit notes and lost customers as the cost.

labels.quote: What would help now is an importer that reads the new format
labels.note: Explicit, and scoped to before the ERP project.

labels.quote: adoption stalled
labels.note: Churn risk at renewal; the tab-switching is why, not a separate signal.

labels.quote: If it appeared inside the CMS
labels.note: The customer names the integration that would fix adoption.

labels.quote: Every changeover needs a quality sheet signed on paper and then typed in again upstairs
labels.note: The forty minutes and six changeovers a day size this problem; they are not separate signals.

labels.quote: The operators would need it to work with gloves on
labels.note: A requirement, stated as the condition for adoption. Borderline; labelled as a request because it names something the product must do.

labels.quote: I export three files every fortnight and merge them in Excel
labels.note: Recurring manual work.

labels.quote: the trust has already asked twice why our numbers disagree with theirs
labels.note: Credibility with the trust — a different cost from the manual merge.

labels.quote: A trust-level report that both sides agree on
labels.note: Explicit ask, with the saving quantified.
